# Meshvise

> Industrial supervision (SCADA/IIoT) software, installed on the customer's own server. Thirteen industrial protocols included, one licence per site whatever the number of points, support and every update included. French company, French and English interface.

Meshvise reads PLCs, machine tools, sensors and meters, records every value, raises alarms, calculates performance indicators and shows them in dashboards. It is built for small and mid-size industrial sites: sites with no supervision that still run on notebooks and spreadsheets, and sites whose existing supervision no longer keeps up (AI, performance indicators, business intelligence, equipment of other brands).

The full content of the site, in English and French, is at https://meshvise.com/llms-full.txt

## What Meshvise does

- Acquisition: thirteen protocols in one engine, no module to buy per brand: Modbus TCP, Modbus RTU, OPC UA, BACnet/IP, Siemens S7, MQTT, EtherNet/IP, Beckhoff ADS, REST, WebSocket, Webhook, Sparkplug B, MTConnect. Nothing is lost when the network drops: acquisition resumes where it stopped.
- History: every value recorded and kept as long as the customer decides, on the customer's server.
- Alarms: thresholds and delays tuned not to ring for nothing, email notification, a trace of who took each alarm on and when.
- Indicators: micro-stoppages, availability and night-time consumption calculated from the machines; an indicator says when data is missing.
- Dashboards built with the mouse, synoptics drawn in the browser, live views by building, line or function, rules built by connecting blocks.
- Traceability: every configuration change dated and signed, with rollback.
- AI: the company's own assistant (Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT or any other) connects to Meshvise through MCP, read only. Meshvise hosts no model.

## What Meshvise is not

- Not a functional-safety system: safety stays in the certified PLC.
- Not a predictive-maintenance or machine-learning product.
- Not an MES, a CMMS or a standalone BI tool.

## Pricing (excluding VAT, annual billing)

- On-Premise licence: €2,400 per year per site, whatever the number of machines, points or screens. Includes every feature, support by email within two business days, and every update released during the subscription, major versions included.
- Commissioning (installation, connection of the equipment, getting started): quoted according to the number of devices to connect.
- Trial on the customer's own equipment: on quote.
- Managed operations: on request, not yet available.

## Continuity

- The data stays on the customer's server, in a standard database, readable without Meshvise.
- No data leaves the site; Meshvise works without internet.
- The product is built on standard components: an integrator can take over operations.
- Contract in French, under French law.
